meta.title: fr-065 euphotic
meta.author: Melwyn and Little Bitchard
meta.description: fr-065 euphotic by Melwyn and Little Bitchard, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 6) taken from modland's V2 collection (`pub/modules/V2/Melwyn/coop-Little Bitchard/fr-065 euphotic.v2m`). 120 BPM, 4:54, 16 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
